name: peru-igv
description: Compute, classify and prepare Peru's monthly Impuesto General a las Ventas (IGV) and Impuesto de Promoción Municipal (IPM) for tax year 2026. Covers businesses and habitual suppliers, registration in the RUC, ordinary domestic goods and services, imports and exported services, output tax, documentary and substantive input-credit conditions, mixed-use purchases, carried credits, retenciones, percepciones and construction detracciones. Includes the 2026 rate composition, hospitality MYPE eligibility, SIRE records, Formulario Virtual 621 fields, filing and payment, and the July 2026 imported-service payment module. Use for "Peruvian VAT", "IGV return", "SUNAT 621", "crédito fiscal", "RUC", "exportación de servicios", or "detracción". Produces a reconciled working paper and exceptions for a Peruvian professional to review before filing.
